user_story: As a user, I want to be blocked from logging in if my account is locked so that security is enforced.

positive.title: Successfully blocked login attempt for locked account
steps: User attempts to log in with locked account credentials.
System displays a message indicating the account is locked.
positive.expected_result: User receives a notification that their account is locked and cannot log in.

negative.title: Error message on login attempt with an incorrect password for a locked account
steps: User attempts to log in with a locked account using an incorrect password.
System verifies the account status and checks the password.
System displays an error message for incorrect password.
negative.expected_result: User receives a notification that the password is incorrect without indication of the account being locked.

edge.title: Account locks after the maximum number of failed login attempts
steps: User attempts to log in with a locked account using the maximum number of allowed failed passwords.
System displays a message indicating the account is now locked due to too many failed attempts.
edge.expected_result: User is informed that their account is locked after exceeding failed login attempts.
